Lock-In Lab

Sleeper Lock-In counts one game per player per week, and you choose which one.

How it works

Each starter's one best game you choose counts for the week. Other games don't count.
After a game ends you can lock it, but before his next game tips. Locks can't be undone.
Players must be in your starting lineup before tip-off. Forget to lock and his team's last game of the week counts, even a DNP.

What it means for drafting

Ceiling beats consistency. Boom-bust scorers gain value since you keep the booms.
Missed games hurt less. A guy who sits one game a week still gives you a score.
Volume matters. More games in a week means more chances at a big night.

Biggest Lock-In risers

Players whose rank improves most with the Lock-In boost on.

Pick a player, flip his games one at a time, and decide when to lock. The optimal play is shown so you learn the thresholds.

Scoring & model

Match these to your Sleeper league settings (League → Settings → Scoring). Everything recalculates instantly.

Points per stat

Starts on Sleeper's default NBA scoring. If your league is set up differently, type the exact numbers here.

Model

Win nowRebuild
Trust modelTrust experts
Horizon
How the score works. Each player's fantasy points per game are projected forward season by season with the age curve (young players grow, 30+ decline), multiplied by expected availability, and discounted by your window setting. With Lock-In on, per-game value is raised by each player's estimated game-to-game volatility (boom games count more) and missed games are penalized less. That model score is then blended with the expert ranking using the trust slider.

Startup strategy

Pick an approach for the startup. Each card re-runs your board through that strategy and shows who it likes most. Whatever you choose powers the Best for your strategy pick in the Draft Room, right next to the overall best pick.

How each strategy ranks your top 30

green = that strategy likes him 5+ spots more than your overall board, red = 5+ spots less
